description: The picking queue — the Picking page's board. Each pick list is one warehouse's picking work for a sales order, transfer order, work order or vendor return, with its stage (waiting_for_inventory, ready, picking, completed), whether stock is available for a list not yet started, priority, picker and quantities. Defaults to open lists (not started or in progress), oldest first. Call get_pick_list for a list's lines and pick locations.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

search.description: Search text: pick list number, order number, customer, or an item's name or SKU.

stage.description: Board column: waiting_for_inventory, ready, picking or completed. Overrides status.

status.description: open (default: not started or in progress), not_started, in_progress, completed or all.

name: list_pick_lists
title: Pick Lists
